blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tax planning means organising your business and your money in a legal way. The goal is to pay less tax. It is not about hiding income or breaking rules. You use the rules the way the government made them.

Here are simple examples. You can pay into a pension to lower the money that is taxed. You can time a big purchase so it falls in a year with more profit. You can choose the right legal structure for a new business. Each one is legal. Done well, it can save real money over the years.

Good tax planning is quiet and patient. It is the opposite of last-minute tricks. It is often the difference between paying a fair tax and paying more than you needed to.

items.q: What is tax planning?
options: Paying tax at the last minute
Organising your money in a legal way to pay less tax
items.why: "Tax planning means organising your business and your money in a legal way. The goal is to pay less tax."

items.q: Which of these is an example of tax planning?
options: Paying more tax than you need
Waiting until the last day to act
Not telling the government about your income
Paying into a pension to lower the taxed money
items.why: "You can pay into a pension to lower the money that is taxed."

items.q: The text says good tax planning is…
items.why: "Good tax planning is quiet and patient."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You can choose a legal structure for a new business.
Small, patient moves can save money.
A good tax trick is one you use at the last minute.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que planejamento é o oposto de truques de última hora.

items.q: The phrase "paying more than you needed to" suggests that…
options: many people pay too much tax without planning
items.why: Inferência: sem planejar, você pode pagar mais do que o justo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie ajudar um novo dono de empresa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, thanks for coming in. This is your first full year, so let's plan it well from the start.

First, I think you should pay into a pension. It is legal, and it lowers the money that is taxed. You do not have to pay a lot. A small amount every month is enough.

Second, you told me you want to buy new equipment. My advice is simple. You ought to time that purchase. Buy it in a year when you have more profit. That way it helps your tax the most.

Please remember, this is not a trick. We are not hiding anything. We are using the rules the way they were made. Everything here is fair and legal.

You should not wait until the last minute. Last-minute moves are stressful and they rarely help. Quiet, patient planning is what saves you real money over the years. Let's do a little each month, and I will check the numbers with you. Does that sound good?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's first piece of advice?
options: Pay into a pension to lower the taxed money
Wait until the end of the year
items.why: "First, I think you should pay into a pension… it lowers the money that is taxed."

items.q: When should the owner buy the new equipment?
options: In a year when he has more profit
items.why: "Buy it in a year when you have more profit."

items.q: How does Sophie describe the plan?
items.why: "Everything here is fair and legal."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "you should not wait until the last minute"?
options: Because last-minute moves are stressful and rarely help
items.why: Inferência: ela contrasta os truques de última hora com o planejamento calmo e paciente.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela explica com calma, tranquiliza o cliente e propõe passos simples.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We use tax planning to pay less every year." Tax planning is…
options: organising your money in a legal way to pay less tax
a way to hide money from the government
a fine you pay to the state
items.why: Tax planning = planejamento tributário: organizar as finanças legalmente para pagar menos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A pension ___ lowers the money that is taxed."
items.why: Pension contribution = contribuição previdenciária.

items.q: "You should time the purchase for a good year." To time something means to…
options: choose the right moment for it
items.why: To time = cronometrar, escolher o melhor momento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This is not a ___; it is legal and fair."
items.why: Last-minute trick = truque de última hora; aqui o oposto do que Sophie faz.

items.q: "You must choose the right legal structure for the business." A legal structure is…
options: the legal form of the business
items.why: Legal structure = estrutura jurídica da empresa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem quando falamos de impostos e finanças. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The accountant has to sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente.

items.q: "We agreed the plan, but we must follow through." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Let's set aside some money for the pension each month." To set aside means to…
items.why: Set aside = separar/guardar dinheiro para um fim.

items.q: "A small saving each year adds up over time." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, ir se acumulando até virar bastante.

items.q: "We should not put off the plan until December." To put off means to…
items.why: Put off = adiar, deixar para depois.
